content.value_statement: Growing an email list safely requires clear offers, consent evidence, and channel priorities. This skill turns your audience, offer, and goals into a practical opt-in growth plan.
actual_capabilities: Designs acquisition channel mixes for owned, earned, and paid handoffs.
Creates lead magnet and signup incentive concepts matched to the audience.
Specifies single or double opt-in flows and consent evidence to capture.
Defines referral loop mechanics with safeguards against low-quality signups.
Sets subscriber growth, cost per opt-in, and confirmation-rate targets.
Prepares handoff notes for consent registry and lifecycle email planning.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, popups, or landing page user interfaces.
Does not write welcome emails or double opt-in confirmation copy.
Does not record consent records or compute email quality scores.
Provides compliance guidance, not legal advice for any jurisdiction.

use_cases.title: Launch a Newsletter Growth Plan
use_cases.description: Plan channels, incentives, and opt-in targets before promoting a new newsletter.

use_cases.title: Improve SaaS Lead Capture
use_cases.description: Turn product education assets into a consent-aware email acquisition plan.

use_cases.title: Add Referral Growth
use_cases.description: Design a recommendation loop that rewards sharing without lowering subscriber quality.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Growth Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple audience and goal.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email list growth for my audience: [audience]. Current signup source: [source]. Goal: [target] by [date].

prompt_templates.title: Lead Magnet Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a lead magnet and opt-in capture flow for [offer]. Audience: [audience]. Jurisdiction: [US, EU, Canada, or other].

prompt_templates.title: Referral Loop Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Add sharing mechanics to an existing list.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a referral loop for my newsletter. Current list size: [number]. Main signup source: [source]. Quality concern: [concern].

prompt_templates.title: Full Acquisition System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full list growth plan for [business]. Include channels, lead magnet, consent evidence, referral mechanics, targets, and handoffs.

output_examples.input: Grow a B2B newsletter from 2,000 to 3,000 subscribers in one quarter.
output: Channel plan: LinkedIn posts, partner webinar, and website content upgrades.
Lead magnet: practical checklist tied to the newsletter promise.
Targets: subscriber growth, cost per opt-in, and confirmed opt-in rate.

output_examples.input: Design a compliant double opt-in flow for a new product guide.
output: Capture flow: signup form, confirmation step, and welcome handoff.
Consent evidence: timestamp, source, checkbox wording, lawful basis, and optional IP data.
Caveat: confirm jurisdiction-specific requirements with qualified counsel.

output_examples.input: Add referrals to an existing creator newsletter.
output: Referral mechanic: tracked share link with a relevant subscriber reward.
Quality guardrail: reward only confirmed subscribers with early engagement.
Handoff: send economics questions to monetization planning if payouts are needed.

best_practices: Provide current list size, signup source, growth history, and jurisdiction before planning.
Label targets as estimated or user-provided, and compare results against your own trailing rate.
Confirm before saving any growth plan or consent capture notes to memory.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to build the signup page or popup user interface.
Do not ask it to make universal legal claims about double opt-in requirements.
Do not invent benchmark conversion rates when your own data is unavailable.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a list growth plan with channels, incentives, opt-in flow details, referral mechanics, and measurable targets.

faq.question: Does it create signup page designs?
faq.answer: No. It specifies the growth strategy and capture flow, then hands page design to a landing optimization skill.

faq.question: Can it handle double opt-in planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains when to use single or double opt-in and what consent evidence to capture.

faq.question: Does it store consent records?
faq.answer: No. It prepares candidate consent details for a consent registry to formalize later.

faq.question: Can it plan referral programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It defines referral mechanics, incentives, attribution, and quality safeguards for new subscribers.

faq.question: Is the compliance advice legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It gives planning guidance and recommends qualified counsel for jurisdiction-specific requirements.
